title: A Static for the Machine
author: Marguerite Eriksen
blurb: Wren Montrose, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
